# Fresh Tentacle mutation payload encoder fixtures

These five front/data pairs were generated on 2026-10-15 in an owned,
daemonless Testcontainers container using the pinned Ceph 20.2.4 image and
source commit `7f793731f1b39eb4f465e960113d2363c311b964`.
[The receipt](mutation-native-provenance.json) records source/submodule,
generated CMake configuration, wrapper, library and binary hashes, loader
audit, execution and cleanup evidence.

The independent C++ wrapper constructs new MOSDOp/MOSDOpReply objects,
asserts that their front/data segments are empty, directly calls native
`encode_payload(features)` and asserts the selected version is 6. The library
and wrapper were built together from unchanged pinned Ceph implementation
files with official CMake-generated configuration. No installed-library ABI
guess, imported decoded front, socket capture or Go-generated payload is used.
The first native request's 519-byte front and 11-byte data match Go completely.

The four replies cover all-success, exclusive-create EEXIST, plain CMPEXT
mismatch and a freshly constructed TRUNCATE. They preserve native constructor
READ/WRITE/RETURNVEC flags and ONDISK, legacy version 19 and replay version 20
at epoch 11. The mismatch has FAILOK unset. TRUNCATE is not a capture of live
ZERO normalization; that is a separate server test. The nine-operation request
covers the implemented mutation/guard unions, flags and ordered binary input.

This proves these feature-selected payload bytes. Messenger header bytes,
server execution, durability, placement and unsupported event/opcode encoders
are outside this offline proof. Earlier `mutation-*` Python/native-decoder
fixtures remain separately labeled and are not retroactively encoder output.

Reproduce with the development-only fixture module's public Testcontainers
lifecycle. Development packages are installed only inside its owned builder;
the Go product still builds and runs without native dependencies or CGO.

```sh
go -C integration/fixture run . encode-osd-mutations -project ../.. \
  -cache /tmp/ceph-native-encoder-cache \
  -output /tmp/ceph-native-encoder-proof.json
CGO_ENABLED=0 go test ./internal/osd \
  -run 'TestMutationRequestMatchesFreshNativeEncoder|TestDecodeFreshNativeEncoderMutationReplies'
```

The optional cache retains downloaded source, dependencies and build outputs.
Omitting it uses a temporary cache. The builder has a 28-minute total budget;
its logs go to the output path plus `.log`. Its receipt validates source,
image, wrapper and all five front/data pairs before reporting success, and
public Terminate must complete before the proof file is written. A cached
run of this repository command regenerated all ten segments identically;
independent Docker inspection confirmed its owned builder was removed.

The referenced Ceph headers/library carry LGPL-2.1 notices. These files are
wire facts generated by an independent development wrapper, not copied native
implementation or a product dependency. Source URLs and file hashes are in
the provenance receipt.
